title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
description: Find the maximum profit from one buy and one sell transaction.

data.text: Given an array `prices` where `prices[i]` is the price on day `i`, return the maximum profit from one transaction. If no profit is possible, return `0`.

**Input:** `prices = [7, 1, 5, 3, 6, 4]`

**Output:** `5`  (buy on day 2 at 1, sell on day 5 at 6)
Try every pair of days (buy, sell). O(n²) time.

data.title: Brute Force O(n²)

data.text: Keep the lowest price seen so far. At each day, compute profit if we sell today. O(n) time, O(1) space.

data.title: One Pass O(n)

data.text: Find local minima (valleys) and local maxima (peaks). Buy at every valley and sell at the next peak. O(n) time, O(1) space.

data.title: Peak-Valley O(n)
What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n²) → O(n). **Space:** O(1) both ways. The one-pass approach remembers the cheapest day so far and checks the profit for every new day.

cards.title: One Pass
cards.description: Track min price, compute profit on the fly

cards.title: Peak-Valley
cards.description: Buy at valleys, sell at peaks
